initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is -0.4, but the arithmetic verification does not establish causal identification. Request archived design record R290-2 to assess whether the causal risk difference is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: The design record establishes random assignment, full compliance, positivity, consistency, and no interference, identifying the causal effect from the population contrast: 1/10 − 20/40 = −0.4.
